title: The Rate a Charge Owed on a Certificate of Deposit Runs At
content:
Where a charge is owed on a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line, the rate it runs at is graded by the owner's borrowing with Piedmont Crescent Bank.

## 1. The grades

The rate the entry runs at is graded: an owner with an auto loan at the bank that is not past due and at least 12 payments posted to it is charged at the tier's published standard interest rate; an owner with an auto loan at the bank that is not past due and fewer than 12 payments posted to it is charged at the rate the certificate carries less the tier's jumbo bonus points; every other owner is charged at the rate the certificate carries.

## 2. What is read

The loan is one of the bank's Auto Loans, and two things are asked of it: whether it stands as not past due, and how many payments have been posted to it. The count of 12 is a floor, so exactly 12 payments posted satisfies it.

## 3. Condition and result

| The owner's auto loan | Payments posted to it | Rate the entry runs at |
|---|---|---|
| held, not past due | 12 or more | the tier's published standard interest rate |
| held, not past due | fewer than 12 | the rate the certificate carries, less the tier's jumbo bonus points |
| held, but past due | any | the rate the certificate carries |
| none held | — | the rate the certificate carries |

## 4. Worked readings, on hypothetical figures

A certificate carrying 4.15 percent on a tier publishing a standard interest rate of 3.97 percent and jumbo bonus points of 0.10.

| The owner's borrowing | Rate the entry runs at |
|---|---|
| an auto loan not past due, 31 payments posted | 3.97 percent |
| an auto loan not past due, 4 payments posted | 4.05 percent, being 4.15 less 0.10 |
| an auto loan past due, 31 payments posted | 4.15 percent |
| no auto loan | 4.15 percent |

The second grade subtracts the jumbo bonus points the tier publishes whether or not the certificate's own rate actually carries them, the deduction being from the rate the certificate carries.
